reserved.rule: No model-driven tuning or paid calibration on reserved templates; authoring/conformance is permitted and does not make templates secret.

intake_structures.purpose: One prerequisite plus an independent alternative
Delayed three-step payoff versus an independent fact
Shared prerequisite unlocks two facts, competing with an independent fact
AND-join payoff versus an independent fact
AND-join followed by a delayed terminal fact

customer_structures.structure: One authorized document, two snapshot cutoffs
Two live authorities disagree; priority outranks revision
Fact-scoped primary revocation with live fallback
Live-revoked-live history; snapshot selects revision before status
Different requested facts legitimately resolve to different documents
Scope filtering before revision/status; foreign-scope revocation must not spread
Future primary record versus currently live fallback and unrelated future distractor
Current proposal binding after supersession; larger or lexically later archived IDs are not authoritative

reserved_customer_structures.structure: Three authorities with mixed per-fact revocation and snapshot filtering
Two sequential proposal deliveries with current-ID rebinding and stale confirmation rejection

witness_search.selection: Lexicographic enumeration of authored finite parameter grid; no LLM results used. Keep only one-coordinate contrasts with feasible plans and different optimal first batches; at least one cross-variant first batch must be objectively suboptimal or illegal, not merely another optimal ordering.
witness_search.scope: Public planning witnesses only, not admitted refund cases or shared-runner trajectory conformance.

intake: public cost/utility profiles and permission configurations, fixed identically within each pair except its declared intervention
seed_variation.non_independence: Renaming IDs, reordering records, prices and repetitions do not create independent structural units.

admission_requirements: Existing category policy, rule precedence and compiled oracle must agree.
Each pair changes one authored primitive coordinate; derived authoritative facts/reference outputs are separately verified, never counted as additional independent interventions.
Material intake nodes map to real required fact IDs; dependencies are public collection/access prerequisites, not hidden policy rules.
Canonical transitive-closure graph signatures reject isomorphic renaming and redundant-edge fake diversity.
Disclosure pairs must change authoritative requested values and expected policy meaning.
Confirmation pairs must change reference proposal binding; policy meaning may remain unchanged.
Invariance pairs must preserve authoritative disclosure, policy resolution and binding; report separately, never as sensitivity.
All facts must have an unambiguous live authorized source at every requested snapshot.
No prompt/schema/guard conflict; schema-only errors remain contract-only.
Four-seat full trajectory conformance, independent references, negative controls, and replay pass before paid execution.
Review utility weights and source-access prerequisites normatively; provider-free success is not human QC.
Expand intake phase/action bounds to four rounds and verify all loops before instantiating witnesses that require four rounds.

measurement_plan.primary: Seat-scoped strict compliance including own contract; never substitute policy_semantic for an active intake/customer outcome.
diagnostics: pair joint pass by effect type
measurement_plan.weighting: Predeclare equal authored structure weights within seat; deduplicate reference trajectory groups within structure; average matched seeds/repetitions inside groups, not as additional independent units.
measurement_plan.dependence: Graph families are structural diversity targets, not an assertion of IID samples. Cluster related policy scenarios and shared canonical graphs conservatively; inspect cross-family overlaps before any inferential plan.
measurement_plan.statistics: Descriptive developmental calibration only until real instances, complete equivalence/deduplication audit, balanced-model calibration and power planning are approved.

next_gate: Implement and review V7 case instantiation/reference bindings, then provider-free gates; a separately approved model/budget/profile/stop contract is required for any paid smoke.
